title: Out_of_memory cannot be caught for Array.make or Bytes.create
summary: `Array.make` or `Bytes.create` of 2^40 elements ends the program with `Fatal error: Out of memory` in place of raising `Out_of_memory`, in native code and bytecode. OCaml 5.4.0 raises, and `stdlib.mli` documents the exception for array creation.

actual.text: Prints `Fatal error: Out of memory`; exit status 134.
